2117255670403870949.content_en:
In Japan it's all lumped together as "overseas FX", but FX is fundamentally a global
financial business.
In the UK there's INFINOX, in Australia IC Markets, and Exness and ATFX also have entities and bases in multiple countries, operating around the world.
In 2023 ATFX acquired Rakuten Securities Australia, and the following year it switched to the ATFX brand.
Every country has its own FX brokers, and on top of that, while following each country's rules,
they expand their business overseas too.
Japan has domestic FX companies too, and that's fine.
But why does Japan separate domestic and overseas so much?
I understand investor protection is needed,
and I don't take that lightly, but regulating and closing off the market are different things.
Rather than just protecting the domestic market,
I think we could consider an environment where people can properly use the world's financial services under proper
rules, competing with the world.
Not toward closing, but toward connecting with the world.
That's what I think🦅

2118871238798135704.content_en:
Good morning! Doing my Saturday morning session 📈

After finishing my backtesting and doing the usual reflection,
I was staring at charts the whole time.

What you often hear is that
there are all sorts of settings like indicators and MAs, but the one thing everyone ends up looking at in common is the candlestick…

I looked into it 👀

If the time basis differs between overseas and domestic, the candlestick shape also changes
For example, on Exness you can check "the value at a certain time" at the close of the 4-hour candle, whereas at Hirose Tsusho the candle is still forming and isn't confirmed until 3 hours later
Even if it surges, if it fully retraces, you get a large so-called power bar on one side and a big upper wick on the other

So what should I look at and trust?

That probably
depends on each trader…

By the way, this article
is written by a guy who has lost every trade this month…

Anyway! Let's do our best next week too 💪
Thanks for your hard work this week, fellow traders ✨
2118871238798135704.content_original:
おはです！土曜日朝活やってます📈

検証を終えて、いつも通りの反省をして、
ずーっとチャートを眺めていました。

よく聞くのが、
インジケーターやMAなど色々な設定はあれど、結局皆が見ている唯一の同じものはローソク足…

調べてみたら👀

海外と国内で時間の基準が違うとローソク足の形も変わる
例えばExnessでは「ある時間の値」を4時間足の終値で確認できる一方、ヒロセ通商では目下形成中で3時間後まで足が確定しない
急騰しても全モしたら、大きめの俗にいうパワーバーと、片や大きな上ヒゲになる…

では何を見て信じればいいのか？

それはきっと
トレーダーそれぞれなのでしょう。。

というかこの記事、
今月、全敗してる男が書いてるんだぜ…

それでは！来週も頑張りまっそーぅ💪
トレーダーの皆様1週間お疲れ様でした✨
